text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That running did not do the Mejiro name
justice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I put on a pitiful performance for all to
see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: なら、すべきことは1つだけ！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thank you for such reassuring
words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall redouble my efforts, so please
join me in
the endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must accept the truth and use this as a
learning
experience. Ultimately, I've
been granted an
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Faltering here would bring dishonor to
the Mejiro
name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I will be tough and work hard. Go,
go, me!
